title: Follow Your River to Allah's Will
body:
Dastoor yaa Sayyidee, madad. (Mawlana Shaykh stands.)
Allahu akbar, Allahu akbar, Allahu akbar la ilaaha illa-Llah, Allahu akbar, Allahu akbar, wa lillahi 'l-hamd!
Huuuu, Huuuuu, Huuuuu.
All praises, and all glory to be on the most honored servant of the Lord of Heavens, Sayyidina Muhammad
(s). Alfu salaat, alfu salaam `alayka wa `alaa aalika wa sahaabatik wa man tabi`ahum bi-ihsaan ila yawmi ddeen. Ishfa` lana ya sayyidi 'r-rusuli 'l-kiraam. Allah, Allah. Look at your weak ummah, in which condition
you know. We are looking for your intercession in the Divinely Presence to send us someone to collect our
hearts towards our Lord's Heavenly Presence. (Mawlana Shaykh sits)
Thumma as-salaamu `alayk, yaa Sayyidee, yaa Sultan al-Awliya who has been appointed for arranging
everything on Earth, about our planet's surface as well as under it, as well as all of it! He is responsible for
everything on this planet. And we are asking humbly from our master to help us, because we are on very
dangerous conditions for Mankind on this planet. We are sending our application to our master. That is our
humble and weak desire, for our master to look after ourselves so that we may be on the Right Path towards
our real positions on this planet.

Our Listeners! As-salaamu `alaykum! I am trying to be a listener for what had just been sent to me from holy
lands for awakening the whole of Mankind, whom are living on this Earth. And we are saying, as-salaamu
`alaykum, O Mankind! We are all from Adam and Eve, from their generation. Allah Almighty is saying, “First
I created Adam, and then I created Eve from Adam, to be a couple.” Allah Almighty first created Adam from
earth, but his descendants are not created first time from earth and then their souls entering, no. First
structure or manifestation of Man is from earth (Adam) then our creation comes between men and women.
First creation was from four elements. Allah Almighty created that first one and then mechanism or
manifestation of whole Mankind never going to be as the first one's creation, no. That first one was not
created through the womb of a mum, no.
Allah Almighty created Earth, but after that his generation is not going to be like Adam's creation, no. The
Lord of Heavens makes for a new generation a private place, and is granting that special place to be for a new
generation to be in safety. First Man was created by the Hands of the Lord of Heavens, but after that their
generation is just created through the wombs of mums. But Allah Almighty was not making that Creation by
Himself; He appointed a wakeel, special angels, and angels are beginning the Creation of a new creature
through the wombs of their mums. Only one Allah Almighty (created) by His Divinely Existence, not like the
others which He is giving authority for new Creation, ordering to angels, “Make that new Creation from two
cells.” And angels are working on it for nine months, or a little more or less. Angels are arranging it.
So many foolish ones were asking to make peoples minds to be lost through such a question. They are saying,
“Oh, what do you think? Did the egg come from a hen or did the hen come from the egg?” and people never
know what to answer. Yes, eggs from hens and also hens from chicken. They are asking such a foolish
question, to make people understanding go far away. And Allah Almighty is cutting it and saying about the
first Creation, “I created it from it Earth, but after it I am not using a Creation through a womb of a woman,
to bring those elements there, no. I am making two cells, cells from man and cells from woman, to come
together. You cannot see Earth or something else there. Then from this cell and that cell, I am creating.”
Once the Lord of Heavens created Man from Earth, but after that He is not creating as He created Adam and
Eve. This is so clear and Allah Almighty appointed angels to give those cells from man and woman. They are
working on it until it becomes a perfect appearance, or perfect personality; a human child. Therefore we are

saying as they are teaching ourselves. This is a big land, big planet, that one who has been ordered to look
after new generations, he knows the secret for making for both cells from women and men to come as a
human child, and that child is either going to be male or female, Allah (swt) knows.
O People! As-salaamu `alaykum! This life is full of secrets. That main reason to come in existence, even you
are not knowing how it happened from two cells a perfect creation came out. What you put in it and what is
coming out. That’s our Lord’s endless Power and maqdiarah (Ability) to do that. This world was empty in the
beginning, nothing was on it. How did it happen that countless kinds creatures are on this planet, belonging
to the plant world or relationship for animals world, how did it happen on Earth? Whom is giving that order
to elements to come together and to be for example, an ant or a bee or a bird? Who is commanding that? He
knows that. No one can understand what is the secret from heavens to be on this planet! Countless kinds of
plants, and also countless figures that are dressed as a man or woman or animals, and no one can say this or
that (about that heavenly secret).
But it is easy for people to say that everything is from nature. Leave that nonsense teaching, to make
everything "from nature". Nature doing this and not doing that. Who is teaching "nature" to a planet, grasses
or flowers? Who is teaching "nature" to countless trees in creation? Who is teaching to nature? Who is that
"nature"? But Shaytan and shaytanic theories making people to loose their ways and to make their minds to
close down. And they are saying, “We don’t know, but it belongs to nature.” What is nature? Heavenly anger
coming on people more than anything else when people are saying, “Nature is bringing grass, nature is
making flowers, nature is creating trees, nature is granting trees different forms, flowers and fruits.” Who is
making this?
O Our Listeners! At least you must understand when you are looking at nature, on this planet there is
Someone’s will power (iraadatullah). But don’t think that that will power is coming from themselves. Are
fruits are choosing, “I like to be an apple tree, grape tree, orange tree, this tree, that tree." This flower, these
roses? No one can saying, “I did this or I did that.” So different. That is giving the biggest proof to people who
are denying the existence of the Creator. How are you are saying, “No creator.” How is it that an apple tree is
not going to be a fig tree, by their will power? Do you think that trees have a will power? Or do you think that
the most perfect creature on Earth has a will power? If they can be authorized to make something, then they
may say, “I like to be this or to be that.” That means no one is making them a creature, that may command

and ask or prefer or may like a fig tree. May say, “I like to be grape tree.” An apple tree may say, “I may be a
pear tree.” No. That means nothing on the surface of this planet, different kinds of plants, different kinds of
flowers and roses and countless trees, countless fruits can be by themselves, but it’s not true.
A tree must follow a direction that it is directed, not through themselves, but from out of themselves. That
will power is not from Earth, because it is not a material thing. Will power is something that no is one is
knowing its reality or position. But people have some appearances of their will power and it is a grant from
Lord of Heavens that He can do as He likes. Therefore, your will is something else, your wife’s will is
something else, and your neighbor's will is something else. Don’t think that every plant, its will going to be
same as the same tree. There are so many orange trees, but the will of the one is not 100% same as the second
tree. That means Who is creating or Who created this planet, is using His Will Power. And Will Power
belongs to the Creator only. We are thinking that we have a will power, but tt is only as an appearance. Not
real reality with us, to be in this existence as a man or woman. Who can say, “I can do through my will,
through my mom’s womb. I like to be male or female.” No one can say!
O our listeners, think on it! You can find `azhamat, Holy Greatness for creatures! He knows, no one can
know. Because Absolute Will Power is for the Creator. Not for anything, not even an atom can say, “Oh My
Lord! You changed my existence through this planet or universe, I’m going to change it or You change it.” If
he can’t do anything by himself, as we said if he is asking to be a male or female child. No one can do that and
can say, “This new coming generation, I like that one to be a male one or to say I like it to be a female one.”
No! That means real existence, real Will Power only for One. Can’t be for two people!
Therefore from this point you can do Christians belief, they are so wrong. No you can’t do. You can’t use your
will through this planet. You can’t change anything. And people saying that technology reaching to a place
where there can’t be any change by Man’s power or by Man’s will power. Up to there, people are thinking,
“We can do this, we can do that.” No, you can’t do anything. To do or to make or to create is only for One, the
Lord of Heavens who created this. Therefore save way for Mankind is to follow steps of the Lord of Heavens
to be in safety here and Hereafter. If you are not putting your will to be with Divinely Will, you will always be
losing and you are going to be in a very bad condition here and Hereafter.
Therefore, the most important acting of a person, man or woman, is to be able to step on steps of Heavens. If

you are changing your steps, then you are falling in an endless trouble ocean. Who is in safety here and
Hereafter? Who can following steps of anbiya and prophets and holy prophets and their holy successors. O
People, please try to think on it. Don’t say, “I can do as I like.” Because if you are claiming this, sometimes
some conditions are coming to prevent you from passing forward. Therefore, Mankind, if they are asking for
happiness, safety and enjoyment and satisfaction here and Hereafter; they must look at these steps, heavenly
steps of heavenly people whom are always stepping on heavenly steps. If you can follow them, you shall be
able to reach your last wish, last demand, and last target.
O Believers! You must run as rivers are running through valleys. Don’t try to change to streaming of a river in
another way; you can loose. Now they are trying to make a dam. It’s not true. That means, “We can change
everything on Earth.” You can’t change. The beginning of that water (is going) to be dried, then what will you
do with the dam? Now people are trying to change their real aspects for reaching on that and they are saying
“We don’t like this, we like that.” The most dangerous claiming is from servants saying, "I like this, I don’t
like that.” Follow your river towards where it is running and you will be in safety and satisfaction. If you are
saying, “I may change (creation),” you can’t change.
Therefore, most important point for Mankind to look after is to follow water through its valley. That is easy
for them and most beneficial. This is important point that mostly people are denying, and they are asking to
use their will power. That makes them fall down, to not stand up. Therefore ittiba`, following Holy
Commands is safety for you here and Hereafter, and it is your paradise to follow a valley towards where it is
running.
May Allah (swt) forgive us. All troubles on Earth today now, which they call “crisis,” one reason for it is
because people are asking to make their life-system as they are planning through their minds. No, it is not
true, because He is your Creator. He’s the Only One who can change your direction from there to there. Keep
the right way. You will be happy here and Hereafter. May Allah (swt) forgive us.
Dome dome dome dome 4x
Therefore, in nature, through Creation, you can find such a beautiful harmony. When you are interfering with
it, using your mind, you will fall into troubles. Follow the way and you will reach to your Lord's Divinely
Presence. Every trouble, behind it there is ignorance. Ignorance is the most dangerous enemy for Mankind,

because ignorance is a shaytanic production. No need for a person to be ignorant. From everything he can
take so many wisdoms and may learn countless teachings. That is safety for them here and Hereafter, but if
you are opposing, you can't be in safety here and Hereafter.
May Allah (swt) forgive us.
Fatihah.
